svg.text: Lab 2 — Multi-Region ML Serving with BGP Failover
High Availability ML Inference using BGP and Health Checks

g.text: 1. Users send requests to a single VIP (BGP router)
2. BGP routes traffic to healthy region (Primary: LP 200)
3. Health checks monitor model servers in both regions
4. If Primary fails, BGP automatically withdraws route
& diverts all traffic to Failover region (LP 100)
5. Service remains 100% available with zero downtime
Same model (Whisper) deployed in two regions
BGP routing with health checks & VPC Peering
Automatic failover on primary region failure
1. Send test inference requests (routes to Region A)
2. Manually kill model server in Region A (/admin/kill)
3. Verify BGP withdraws route & traffic shifts to Region B
4. Confirm inference still 100% works from Region B
When one region fails, traffic automatically routes to the other region via BGP, ensuring continuous ML inference service.
